zeitlin2013.citation: Zeitlin C. et al. Measurements of energetic particle radiation in transit to Mars on the Mars Science Laboratory. Science 340:1080-1084 (2013).
zeitlin2013.evidence: Measured. One instrument (MSL RAD) inside the cruise stage, 253 days.

hassler2014.citation: Hassler D.M. et al. Mars' surface radiation environment measured with the Mars Science Laboratory's Curiosity rover. Science 343:1244797 (2014).
hassler2014.evidence: Measured on the surface, one instrument (RAD). The full-mission value is a model estimate.

std3001.citation: NASA Space Flight Human-System Standard, Volume 1: Crew Health, Rev B (2022). Radiation Technical Brief.
std3001.evidence: Standard. The career limit uses a cancer-risk model only.

std3001appF.citation: NASA Space Flight Human-System Standard, Volume 2: Human Factors, Habitability, and Environmental Health, Appendix F (display and alert classes).

noaaScale.citation: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center. Space Weather Scales: Solar Radiation Storms (S1 = 10 pfu of protons at 10 MeV or more).
noaaScale.evidence: Operational definition. Check against the DONKI SEP definition before the pitch.

donki.citation: NASA CCMC Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information (DONKI): FLR, CME, and SEP records.
donki.evidence: Event catalog near Earth. It does not measure dose at the vehicle.

berger2024.citation: Berger T. et al. Artemis I radiation measurements. Nature (2024).
berger2024.evidence: Measured in phantoms on Orion. Validate: add the DOI before the pitch.

team.citation: CSI team value for the Space Apps 2026 demo. Not a NASA flight rule. See PRD CSI-HM-PRD-001 Rev C, section 07.

lee2020sans.citation: Lee A.G. et al. Spaceflight associated neuro-ocular syndrome (SANS) and the neuro-ophthalmologic effects of microgravity: a review and an update. npj Microgravity 6:7 (2020).
lee2020sans.evidence: Review. Changes in near vision are a common first sign. Diagnosis needs an eye exam.

law2014co2.citation: Law J. et al. Relationship between carbon dioxide levels and reported headaches on the International Space Station. J Occup Environ Med 56(5):477-483 (2014).
law2014co2.evidence: Observational, ISS crews. Headache odds rise with cabin CO2.

leblanc2000bone.short: LeBlanc et al., J Musculoskelet Neuronal Interact 2000
leblanc2000bone.citation: LeBlanc A. et al. Bone mineral and lean tissue loss after long duration space flight. J Musculoskelet Neuronal Interact 1(2):157-160 (2000).
leblanc2000bone.evidence: Measured, Mir crews. Hip bone loss of about 1 to 1.6% per month.

barger2014sleep.citation: Barger L.K. et al. Prevalence of sleep deficiency and use of hypnotic drugs in astronauts before, during, and after spaceflight. Lancet Neurol 13(9):904-912 (2014).
barger2014sleep.evidence: Observational, shuttle and ISS crews. Mean sleep under 6 h a night in flight.

hrpBmed.citation: NASA Human Research Program. Risk of Adverse Cognitive or Behavioral Conditions and Psychiatric Disorders. Evidence report.
hrpBmed.evidence: Evidence report. Mood and sleep trends are early signs. Thresholds here are team values.

iaeaArs.citation: IAEA. Medical Management of Radiation Injuries. Safety Reports Series No. 101 (2020). Prodromal signs of acute radiation syndrome.
iaeaArs.evidence: Clinical guidance. Nausea and vomiting are prodromal signs at doses far above the doses in this demo.

hrpCardio.citation: NASA Human Research Program. Risk of Cardiovascular Adaptations Contributing to Adverse Mission Performance and Health Outcomes. Evidence report.
hrpCardio.evidence: Evidence report. Heart rate limits here are team values for the demo.
